1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan-Jalan Persekutuan

(Pengurusan Persendirian) (Pungutan Tol) (Lebuh Raya DamansaraPuchong)

(Pindaan) (No. 3) 2015.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 Oktober 2015.

Pindaan perenggan 2

1. Perintah Jalan-Jalan Persekutuan (Pengurusan Persendirian) (Pungutan Tol)

(Lebuh Raya DamansaraPuchong) 1999 [P. U. (A) 27/1999], yang disebut

"Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam subperenggan 2(1)—

(a) dengan menggantikan perkataan "ruang (2) Bahagian I hingga III

Jadual Pertama mengikut tahun-tahun konsesi," dengan perkataan

"ruang (2) Jadual Pertama";

(b) dengan menggantikan perkataan "ruang (1) Bahagian I hingga III" dengan

perkataan "ruang (1)"; dan

(c) dengan menggantikan perkataan "14 Ogos 2029" dengan perkataan

"14 Ogos 2030".

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(DAMANSARA–PUCHONG HIGHWAY) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 3) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of

the Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Damansara–Puchong Highway) (Amendment) (No. 3)

Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2015.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Damansara – Puchong Highway) Order 1999 [P. U. (A) 27/1999], which is referred

to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1)—

(a) by substituting for the words "column (2) of Parts I to III of the

First Schedule" the words "column (2) of the First Schedule";

(b) by substituting for the words "column (1) of Parts I to III of the

First Schedule according to the consession years," the words

"column (1)"; and

(b) by substituting for the words "14 August 2029" the words

"14 August 2030".

Amendment of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[subparagraph 2(1)]
